The Chimes

Annotated: A Goblin Story of Some Bells That Rang an Old Year Out and a New Year In

On New Year's Eve, Trotty Veck, a poor London messenger, is shown a vision by the goblins of the church bells. Dickens wrote The Chimes in 1844 as his second Christmas book, after A Christmas Carol.

This annotated edition helps you follow the story and the world it was written for.

Questions

What does annotated mean?

The book includes extra notes alongside the story, such as explanations of the history and customs that a modern reader might not know.

Who wrote it?

Charles Dickens. The text is his complete original story.
